docs.text: For those who might need inspiration for a Descent-style horror story, here is your periodic reminder that there is a 16 square mile salt mine in Cleveland, Ohio 1800 feet beneath Lake Erie No, really:
Detroit hides a giant salt mine a quarter mile underground. There are many more salt mines underneath the great lakes region
There’s a huge salt mine beneath Lake Erie. It’s operated out of Cleveland. clevelandmagazine.com/in-the-cle/t...
⚒️ I always regretted not finding an excuse to visit a similar salt mine in Cleveland - with tunnels stretching beneath Lake Erie - when I lived in Ohio.
I am weirdly fascinated by the history of salt and how it shaped civilization. Also the salt mine under lake erie.

We are about to experience what is potentially another historic storm on the eastern shores of Lake Huron. This not only adds to an already historic winter (the worst in at least a decade), there is a serious shortage of rock salt with loads of trucks waiting at the Goderich Salt Mine.
It's heading to its home port on the east shore of Lake Huron, Goderich, Ontario. No need to go through the locks. Goderich is also where the worlds largest road salt mine is.
I was just gonna post about this one – not related to the salt mine but still underneath Lake Erie: www.usdeadlyevents.com/1916-july-24...

🚢 During a recent snowstorm, a Great Lakes freighter, likely having arrived from Goderich on Lake Huron where the world's largest underground salt mine is located, unloads more salt to deal with whatever weather comes our way in the first few months of 2025. urbantoronto.ca/news/2025/01...
Wow— we have a salt mine under Lake Erie, right here in Cleveland. 🧂
I still feel fairly safe here- even though Most of Detroit sits on top of one of the world's largest salt mines, along with at least the western-most part of Lake Huron.
The whole idea creeps the hell out of me. Right up there with the salt mines under Lake Erie.

Thinking of a good place for shell-shocked Aernians to imprison about twenty to thirty people I googled 'bunker below lake erie'. Found out there's a whole salt mine there. So yeah, that's it for my The Last Caravan prep, I guess.

One of things I learned at the Fairport Harbor Lighthouse & Museum in OH is that there was the Morton Salt Company once had a salt mine under Lake Erie in this location. You can read about my visit here: www.markstrecker.com/fairport-har.... #TravelAddictsHistory#lighthouse#nauticalhistory
In a salt mine under Lake Erie where salt for roadways is mined. youtu.be/6sWAD50T9nc?...
1800 ft below Lake Huron, 5 km out. Compass Minerals salt mine

I heard about sand shortages, but this is a new one for me. It's been reported that the mine under Lake Huron has enough salt to keep going for another hundred years. www.compassminerals.com/who-we-are/l...
Wait, there are salt mines UNDER LAKE ERIE?!

I do not understand how we are having a road salt shortage in Northeast Ohio with a huge Cargill Salt Mine under Lake Erie downtown? It is open and producing salt so why the shortage? It seems like a short drive to get some salt? www.cleveland.com/akron/2026/0...
